notes.title: v0.15.0 - 2025-03-25
notes.content:
Store Update & Sale
• Subscription model removed! Packages are now permanent
• To celebrate this, all packages are currently on sale until April 6
• Subspace Pioneer is now a permanent package – previously limited to Early Access + 6 months. Benefits slightly adjusted.
• Introducing Subspace Captain – a new permanent package that replaces the old subscription and includes all its benefits
• Free upgrades: If you’ve spent money before, you’ll automatically receive a permanent package matching your total spend – be sure to claim it from your mailbox at your base
• The package you receive is based on your total spending with a bonus, and converted into a matching permanent package – for free

Skill Update
• [new] Cannon: Barrage class skill added – unleashes a devastating barrage, firing three projectiles in rapid succession three times
• [new] Laser: Solar Lance class skill added – fires a continuous laser, dealing increasing damage over time
• [tune] Skill radius is now animated and tints the background to improve visibility
• [tune] Some combat skills can now be triggered out of combat
• [tune] Skill usage can be canceled
• [tune] Skills can now have their own icons – new icons will be added in the future
• [tune] Absorber damage has been further reduced, as it will be replaced soon

General
• [tune] Damage numbers in combat now have an improved spread to reduce overlap
• [tune] Support tickets should now show the unread indicator more reliably
• [tune] Enemies lurking behind asteroids will no longer jump onto players in their Spacecraft
• [tune] You can now replace a module in the module bar with the same type, even if the limit has already been reached
• [tune] Starting next season, the new base layout will remain consistent instead of shifting randomly due to varying positions on the hex grid
• [tune] Game trailer tools improved in preparation for producing more video material

notes.title: v0.14.18 - 2025-02-10
notes.content:
Skill Update
• [new] Cannon: Charged Impact, damage skill usable by all classes
• [new] Laser: Focus Burn, DoT skill usable by all classes
• [new] Advanced Mining: Fracture, class skill to uncover asteroid cells

Support System
• [new] Support system integrated into game and server; write to us from within the game
• [tune] New support menu now used in the main menu and in-game. The "?" button now leads to the same support menu, which is integrated into the player profile menu

General
• [new] Optional scrolling by moving the mouse to the edge of the screen in fullscreen mode (default disabled). @Craig
• [tune] Fighters have more shield and less hull points to balance out kinetic vs energy weapons
• [tune] Bosses tend to be lower in level for low-level players but scale more if a lot of players are online
• [tune] Encounters are less likely to be much stronger than the player
• [tune] Server maintenance now shows the correct countdown timer, which broke in a previous update
• [tune] Cargo slots title text was drawn outside the window. @JoWhips
• [tune] Skill radius is now drawn last to prevent it from being drawn behind a planet. @Sakuya
• [tune] Fixed some overlapping in the Shipyard for ship stats and reduced the length of "technology" in all translations
• [tune] Corrected labels and buttons for hull, create hull, and module
• [tune] Shipyard no longer shows the skills tab if none have been unlocked, improving the new user experience

notes.title: Playtest v2 - Phase 1
notes.content:
The New Shipyard, Techtree, and Class system, among other features, will soon go live. We invite you to help test this version, which uses a copy of last week's live database.

[b]What to Expect[/b]
- You will find yourself back in your Lifepod.
- Any old v1 ships will be recycled, and you'll receive full compensation.
- Technologies will transfer automatically to the new techtree, and remaining Technology Blueprints will be converted to experience points and the new Datacores.
- The new Shipyard is now the default way to play, with no traces of the old system remaining.

[b]Phase 1[/b]
We are testing the transition to the new V2 system to ensure flawless functionality. Microtransactions can be tested and will last only days (instead of months). All purchases are simulated and require no actual payments.

[b]Phase 2[/b]
In the coming days, the test server will be fully reset, allowing you to start from scratch as a new player. Our goal is to ensure that the new system works equally well for new players and that the balancing feels right.

Once both phases are completed and polished, the final version will go live, marking the conclusion of the first roadmap update and paving the way for future content and changes.
